nodes.skradanie_ok.text.t: The cloak covers what needs covering, and the patrol looks wherever their own self-confidence points them. You pass with the face of an innocent.

nodes.skradanie_pudlo.text.t: Your cloak catches on the gate hinges and the blade glints in the lamplight. "And what's that?" the leader asks quietly, almost with relief. "Gentlemen, we've got him."

nodes.ucieczka.text.t: The leader watches you go for a long time but gives no order. You know he's memorised your face.

nodes.walka.text.t: The leader makes no comment. He draws his club, and his men do the same, in step like on the parade ground.

nodes.wybor.options.[skradanie].text.t: I throw my cloak over the blade and squeeze past the patrol.

nodes.wybor.options.[ucieczka].text.t: I turn around and walk off, unhurried.

nodes.wybor.options.[walka].text.t: I won't show it. But I can show you another way.

nodes.wybor.options.[wymowa].text.t: Do I look like someone who loiters? I only loiter at addresses I know.

nodes.wybor.text.t: "Citizen, we're not looking for trouble. We're only looking for a man with a blade who may be loitering in the area. Would you mind showing us what you're carrying?"

nodes.wymowa_ok.text.t: The leader tilts his head. "Well, you look more like a man who's lost than the one on the paper." The sheet disappears into a pocket, and the patrol parts reluctantly.

nodes.wymowa_pudlo.text.t: "Don't take me for a fool, citizen. I know that tone and I know that look." The leader clenches his teeth and nods to his men, and the clubs rise in unison, as on the parade ground. "Arrest him if you can. If not, too bad."
